scope: Source-proved plain direct/self item spell branches only. No spell effects, action-economy enforcement, inferred ability/DC, charge recovery, fixed-DC/attack, upcast, controller, or altered concentration automation.
fullSnapshotHashMethod: SHA256(JSON.stringify(recursivelySorted(entire normalized Entry))); nonmutating unreserved exact-source alias id and transport-only string revision canonicalization to pinned source values; every other field remains hashed.
inputSha256Method: SHA256 of UTF8 JSON.stringify(parsed original input), original object order retained; not a raw transport-byte hash.
originalRawSha256Method: SHA256 of UTF8 JSON.stringify(recursivelySorted(original source row)), arrays ordered; no normalized category or loader fields.
targetSnapshotSha256Method: SHA256 of UTF8 JSON.stringify(recursivelySorted({raw,entries,effects,choices,dependencies})); undefined object fields omitted; exact ordinaryCastingRule mechanics proof.
targetCanonicalFullSnapshotSha256Method: SHA256 of UTF8 JSON.stringify(recursivelySorted(entire normalized target Entry)), with canonical target id and pinned input revision plus exact per-row lookup revision.
